body:
`solace-cli/build.rs` runs the board's and frontend's `build-release` (bun, gleam) whenever their sources change, writes into their `priv/` folders, and panics if they fail. Under a Rust check that would fail on Gleam errors in another project and need write access to it.

- Move the frontend bundling into the `[build]` plan (D-131 point 6), ordered before the Rust build.
- Leave `build.rs` only embedding the already-built files (rerun when they change).
- A missing bundle gives a clear build error naming the `[build]` step to run.

Independent of the other Rust tasks; must land before `solace-cli/` itself is adopted.
title: Self-build: bundling out of build.rs
